title: Exposure
description: Three real night photos (Times Square in the fog, the signs over the street, light beams through fog) with a quiet white caption that stays readable at every stop, and a camera exposure dial that clicks in thirds of a stop. Turn it up and the neon clips and halates red-orange, the caption blooms and the shadows lift into grain; turn it down and the night crushes to a few lamps. Pick the photo from the small frames under the title.
intent: The blown-out, blooming lyric caption from herb's board turned into one physical control: a real tone curve over scene-referred light, so exposure compensation clips, blooms and halates the way film and phone footage do, now over the best night photos on the site.
